campaign: Eight distinct authorized physical training maps, one original game per map, four seats per side as specified separately in ../native_action_onpolicy_intake/design.json. All eight official outcomes count. No independent exam map, no early stopping on wins.
objective: Full-game natural-return REINFORCE on the actual sampled final team orders, U=0.5*(win+0.5*draw)+0.5*sigmoid(official_margin/1000); always report observed WDL, mean official margin, and mean U separately. Missing or failed trajectory remains in campaign; with fewer than eight usable labels no release eligibility.
behavior: Initial W1 is exactly zero. W0/B0, readout locations, every-six-step pivot and sampling process, prefix/guard/grouping, parent 0.5 mass and ordinary greedy steps are frozen. Train only the 24 fp32 coefficients W1 on behavior-generated official trajectories. Every step's issued order is matched to the complete signed physical support. Log probabilities under the rollout and recomputed policy must agree; ordinary has exactly one order and zero gradient. A single outcome is one sample even if a game reaches 49 stochastic pivots.
baseline: 20 prior signed full games, same incumbent ede48ad9 vs original, two seats on ten distinct disjoint terrains. For pre-action initial cash gap c, seat s and exact step t, b_t is the mean of U(c + terminal_margin_j - public_cash_gap_j(t)) over the ten old games of that seat, evaluating WDL from the hypothetical final margin. Uses no future or action in the current rollout. All archived old games reach 299; failed official outcome, if present among new games, retained outside gradient. No old responses on 540–543 or candidate paired deltas used in fitting. At t0, b0 supplies the scalar baseline for off-policy realized returns.
update: For each real usable game i compute g_i=sum over stochastic steps [(U_i-b_t)*grad log P_old(issued_t)]. Average games equally. One deterministic gradient pass, no minibatching, no imitation or auxiliary losses. Initial tentative W1=0.2*g/max(0.1,||g||2) cast fp32. Halve at most 12 times along this direction until mean stochastic-step old-to-new KL<=0.002, max physical-order TV<=0.08, max observed episode absolute log-likelihood ratio<=0.5. No validation-directed retuning.
held: For each training map leave the whole map out, train same update on the other seven maps and evaluate the actual held trajectory under held policy vs W1=0. Episode ratio is the product of ALL emitted order likelihood ratios, including ordinary=1, in logs. Held gain in U=(ratio-1)*(U-b0); official-margin and WDL matched estimates have the corresponding initial-seat historical means. Show every map, ratios, sign counts, 8-map bootstrap intervals (10000 resamples, seed 25953), ESS, and KL as descriptive only: folds overlap. A centered score from these eight maps estimates a single-step model-selection diagnostic, not strength. No trajectory is independently discarded by score, timing, or advantage. No fresh off-policy actor update with held data during its validation.
development_gate: Requires all eight completed, legal complete supports, both seats represented 4/4, finite terms, immutable archive identity, stable fp32 public replay, a nonzero readout, all full fit/fold-wise support and KL+TV limits, held trajectory abs(log ratio)<=0.5 for each, held estimated U gain average positive and at least five maps with positive held estimated gain. To avoid responding to almost no behavior change: at least one-percent mean stochastic total variation on checked rollout decisions and at least two distinct maps with any emitted command differing for matched common uniforms. If unmet, keep weights and all losses for learning, do not dispatch a strength comparison. If met, only a fresh independently authorized, both-seat incumbent-vs-candidate comparison can establish progress. Ladder resource certification is separate.
